'''Hu al'Dai''' is a resident of the [[Two Rivers]].

==Appearance==
He is an old man.{{ref/book|4|43}}

==History==
He is the son of [[Willim al'Dai]] and father of [[Bili al'Dai]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Willim al'Dai}}

His farm lay between Emond’s Field and Watch Hill.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Hu al'Dai}}

== Activities ==
He fruitlessly calls for his son [[Bili al'Dai]] after [[Perrin]] and his band returns from a battle with [[Trollocs]].{{ref/book|4|43}}
